nodes.name: Note: WF-05c · Order status lookup (agent tool)

parameters.content:
## WF-05c · Order status lookup (agent tool)
Called by the support agent with `{ order_number, email }`.
**Both are required** and must belong together: the order is only returned if the email
matches the customer (or one of its contacts) in Odoo. A wrong combination gets the same
"not found" answer as a non-existent order, so the chat can't be used to probe order numbers.
Every lookup is written to `event_log`.

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ 'WF-05c Order Status Lookup', $json.found ? 'Chat order lookup: ' : 'Chat order lookup without match: ') + $('When Called by Agent').item.json.order_number, JSON.stringify({}), $execution.id ] }}
